# Compa

Compa is a community resilience app built by Integer LLC (Pembroke Pines, Florida) —
helping neighborhoods prepare for, respond to, and recover from disasters, together.
Status: coming soon. Launch updates via the waitlist.

## Pages

- [Home](https://compa.help/): What Compa is, how it works (Prepare / Respond / Recover),
  founder story, waitlist signup, FAQ.
- [For Agencies](https://compa.help/agencies.html): Positioning for FEMA-aligned emergency
  management, CERT programs, and community organizations. Whole Community approach,
  volunteer and CERT coordination, ground-truth community insight for the common
  operating picture, accessibility and equity, and pilot partnerships.
- [Waitlist](https://compa.help/waitlist.html): Join the launch waitlist. Free for residents.
- [Contact](https://compa.help/contact.html): Contact the Compa team.

## Key facts

- Compa complements official emergency management; it does not replace 911, public
  alerting, NIMS/ICS command, or agency authority.
- Compa is not affiliated with or endorsed by FEMA or any government agency.
- Residents: free. Agencies: pilot partnerships structured collaboratively.
- Privacy: residents control what they share; location used only to connect nearby
  help; personal data is never sold.
- Accessibility is a design requirement (WCAG 2.2 AA target), plain-language first,
  with low-bandwidth and multilingual support planned.
